in_sanskrit.name: Mamali
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Durga
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mamali एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mamali is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mama', which means 'Mother'. The suffix 'ali' is derived from the name of the goddess Durga, symbolizing her protective and nurturing nature towards her children. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring strength, courage, and divine protection to the bearer.
